question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Loyal
solution:
The correct answer is **Fickle.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• “**Loyal**” means someone **who is very trustable**.
 
• “**Fickle**” means who is **never fixed on anything, especially when it comes to trust or loyalty**.
 
 
• **Example**: *You should never trust a fickle-minded person*.
 
 
 
• Therefore, “**Fickle” **is the correct antonym for “**Loyal”**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The meaning and usage of the other words are as follows:

 
• “**Ardent**” means very **passionate about something.**

 
 
• **Example**: *He is an ardent follower of Virat Kohli.*
 
 
 
• “**Stupid”** means foolish**.**
 
 
• **Example:** *I have never encountered such a stupid excuse for not coming to the party.*
 
 
 
• “**Tragic**” means **heartbreaking or sad.**
 
 
• **Example**: *His failure in the exam after so much hard work was very tragic.*
